headline: Does Record Q2 Results And AI-Driven Guidance Shift The Bull Case For Amphenol (APH)?
summary: In late July 2026, Amphenol Corporation reported second-quarter 2026 results showing record sales of US$8.76 billion and net income of US$1.77 billion, alongside higher earnings per share versus the prior year. The company also issued upbeat third-quarter guidance, projecting US$9.30 billion to US$9.40 billion in sales, underpinned by strong AI-related IT datacom demand and contributions from recent acquisitions, including CommScope.
